comments.body: My friend (non-eu) looked for 6 months and it was rough. He speaks German fluently and has a masters degree from here. Ended up in Austrua with a so-called blue card. This is for highly skilled workers and was much easier to get. The hard part in Switzerland was to not get sorted out by automated systems.  You fill out Non-EU and you're out. If you do get an interview it is HR, which won't move a finger. As far as I know, France has the same blue card system (I think all European countries do).
comments.author: Recent_Wrangler_1064
